# What should a fractional executive charge to replace a full-time salary?

> Free fractional executive rate calculator: convert a full-time salary into the day rate, hourly rate and monthly retainer that cover unsold days, benefits and payroll tax, then test a client mix against capacity. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
